biography: Phil Dörr, a name now synonymous with calculated precision on the track, didn't come from motorsport royalty. Growing up in a small village nestled in the Bavarian Alps, his first taste of speed came from navigating treacherous mountain roads on his father's old motorcycle. This early experience instilled in him a deep respect for the limits of grip and the consequences of overconfidence. He initially pursued a career in engineering, but the call of the racetrack proved too strong to resist. Dörr made his professional debut in the Synergy Green team, quickly earning a reputation for consistency and reliability. A pivotal moment came during a rain-soaked race at the Nürburgring, where he flawlessly executed a daring strategy call, climbing from tenth to second in the final laps. Now in his prime, Dörr remains a cornerstone of Synergy Green, a steady hand in a sport often defined by volatility.
drivingStyle: Dörr's driving style is characterized by meticulous preparation and unflappable composure. He rarely makes impulsive moves, preferring to patiently analyze the race and exploit opportunities when they arise. He's known for his exceptional tire management skills, often stretching his stints further than his competitors. Dörr approaches corners with a deliberate smoothness, prioritizing exit speed over flamboyant entries. Under pressure, he becomes even more focused, a quality that has earned him numerous podium finishes in challenging circumstances.

careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours in a nail-biting finish, after battling mechanical issues for most of the race, showcasing his resilience and teamwork.
careerLowPoint: Suffering a mechanical failure in the final lap of the championship-deciding race, costing him the title and leaving him visibly shaken.
